description: Portrait of Georgia O'Keeffe's hands - handling a cluster of dark grapes (could be concord grapes)  that are sitting on a large grape leaf; her forearms seem to appear out of a darkness,  the fingers of her right hand (in viewer lower left) are fanned out in a claw-like grasp around the cluster of grapes, her left hand's thumb and forefinger are pinched together holding the stem of the grape leaf.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe - Hands and Grapes
